title: Three Shifts and One Short Switch
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：video　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 video 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the operator ① made the video that no trainee in the station would have recorded, and he said the making was the whole of the shift. The ② video, meaning the clip itself and not the switch, ran three shifts and stayed unrecorded in the book; a video, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ video in that station had the same short switch beside it, and the ④ video at the far screen, meaning the cable they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A video, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the operator said the recording is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the video was the whole of the matter, meaning the memory and not the clip. The ⑥ video, meaning the memory and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; video, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a clip and a memory. He said the memory is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ video had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short switch. The ⑧ video of the whole thing, the operator wrote in June, was one station and three shifts of recording; video, he said, is either the cable at the far screen or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ video I remember is the clip recorded in the log, which closed in 1974 and is still recorded as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ video, my mother said in 1976, is the only clip that improves by being recorded; every video, she said, is a memory that has agreed to look like a clip. She said the memory was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 视频；录像（指机房里每一段旁边的那一段）
B. n. 视频；录像（指那段视频本身，与小小的开关相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the video 录这一段视频
D. n. 视频；录像（指留给孩子们查的那一根）
E. n. 视频之事（抽象总称，指一处机房的视频之事）
F. n. 视频；录像（指运行日志里写到、被记载的那一段）
G. n. 视频、留存（指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 留存（抽象总称，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the video that no trainee in the station would have recorded
The video, meaning the clip itself and not the switch
the video at the far screen

answers.why: make the video 意为“录这一段视频”，1967 年那位操作员把机房里没有一位实习生肯记载的一段视频做了一遍。
video 意为“视频；录像”，指那段视频本身而不是小小的开关，它经过了三个班次而在簿子上没有被记载。
video 意为“视频；录像”，指机房里每一段旁边的那一段，每一段旁边都有同一个小小的开关。
video 意为“视频；录像”，指最远那块屏幕的留给孩子们查的那一根，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
video 意为“视频、留存”，指一件事里人人都按却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段留存就是那件事的全部。
video 意为“留存”，指人人都按却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段视频，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
video 意为“视频；录像”，指运行日志里写到、被记载的那一段，到 1972 年这一段成了运行日志里的一行。
video 意为“视频之事”，操作员六月写道，整件事的视频之事是一处机房和三个班次的记载。
video 意为“视频；录像”，我记得的是运行日志里记载过的那一段，1974 年调好了，至今仍被说成机房里最安静的一段。
video 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，视频是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的视频。
